The booking sites at New Orleans hotels

53 sites, 11 of them at one hotel only. Most hotels listed: Etrip.net at 15 and Vio.com at 15. Fewest sites: Dauphine Orleans Hotel (12); most: Virgin Hotels New Orleans (28).

Etrip.net was lowest at voco St. James Hotel by IHG, Hotel Indigo New Orleans - French Quarter by IHG and Dauphine Orleans Hotel of its 15, and 5%+ above another site at 9. Vio.com was lowest at voco St. James Hotel by IHG, Hotel Indigo New Orleans - French Quarter by IHG and Dauphine Orleans Hotel of its 15, and 5%+ above another site at 9. Agoda was lowest at none of its 13, and 5%+ above another site at 13.

The hotel's own site, at 12 of the 15: lowest at 1 (The Quisby), a median 42% above the lowest site. Nearest: Hotel Indigo New Orleans - French Quarter by IHG, $132 against $123 on Vio.com, Kiwi.com and 2 other sites. Farthest: Hotel Le Marais, $230 against $101 on Super.com.

Lowest at 5%+ below the going rate: Super.com at 7, Etrip.net at 3, Vio.com at 3, goseek.com at 2, Traveluro at 2, Billabook.com at 1, KAYAK.com at 1 and Kiwi.com at 1 (ties count for each). All cities: which booking site was lowest most often.

Taxes and fees in New Orleans

They added a median of 18.0% ($22 a night) to the before-tax going rate. It ran from 10.2% at W.G. Creole House 1850 to 18.9% at voco St. James Hotel by IHG; our data does not split taxes from fees. The 3 listed prices may leave out resort or property fees. More: hotel booking fees explained.

Questions about New Orleans hotel prices

How much is a hotel in New Orleans?

$143 a night all-in at the median (Sep 28, 2026 prices), from $65 at W.G. Creole House 1850 to $215 at Virgin Hotels New Orleans.

Does our data show the cheapest time to book a hotel in New Orleans?

No: these prices come from a few New Orleans dates, not a season.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for New Orleans hotels?

Below the going rate, most often Super.com (7 hotels) and Etrip.net and Vio.com (3 hotels each). The hotel's own site: lowest at 1 of 12.

How we measured this

The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price). The study's method. Words last changed November 23, 2026; prices read September 28, 2026; each hotel's page has every site's price.
